name: CleanroomEnvironmentalMonitoringLog
tagline: GMP cleanroom EM for Power Apps – grade A–D limits, excursions, investigations and trends in one drop-in app.
description: A complete environmental monitoring app for sterile pharmaceutical sites: schedule and record viable and non-viable samples, read incubated plates, see alert and action excursions against EU GMP Annex 1-style grade limits, investigate excursions with deviation references, QA-review results with four-eyes checks and spot adverse trends per sampling point – on canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Grade A–D limits for active air, settle, contact, glove print and particles ≥0.5/≥5.0 µm, in operation and at rest, with site overrides
Alert level as % of action limit; Grade A no-growth rule
Incubation and read rules, organism identification
Deviation-backed excursion investigations with root cause, batch impact and CAPA
Four-eyes QA review e-signature and bulk review of within-limit results
Adverse-trend detection, heat map and trend charts with limit lines
Search, quick filters, grouping, bulk actions, CSV export, undo
Demo mode, map-your-columns guidance, phone layout
